question: Which of the following is NOT one of the seven common characteristics of living organisms? / 下列哪項不是生物的七種共同特徵之一？
All living organisms obtain energy directly from sunlight. / 所有生物都直接從陽光中獲取能量。
What is the process by which living organisms remove metabolic waste products from their bodies? / 生物把體內的代謝廢物排出體外的過程稱為什麼？
Which life process releases energy from food inside living cells? / 哪種生命過程在活細胞內從食物中釋放能量？
Plants show irritability by growing towards light. / 植物向光生長顯示了感應性。
Which organelle controls all cellular activities and contains genetic material (DNA)? / 哪種細胞器控制所有細胞活動並含有遺傳物質（DNA）？
Where does aerobic respiration mainly take place in a eukaryotic cell? / 真核細胞的有氧呼吸主要在哪裡進行？
options: Smooth endoplasmic reticulum / 光面內質網

question: Animal cells have a rigid cell wall made of cellulose. / 動物細胞具有由纖維素組成的堅硬細胞壁。
Which structure is found in plant cells but NOT in animal cells? / 下列哪種結構存在於植物細胞中，但不存在於動物細胞中？
What is the main function of the cell membrane? / 細胞膜的主要功能是什麼？
options: Provide mechanical support / 提供機械支持
Control the movement of substances into and out of the cell / 控制物質進出細胞
Carry out photosynthesis / 進行光合作用

question: Which organelle is responsible for protein synthesis? / 哪種細胞器負責合成蛋白質？
The plant cell wall is fully permeable to water and dissolved substances. / 植物細胞壁對水和溶解物質是全透性的。
What pigment inside chloroplasts absorbs light energy for photosynthesis? / 葉綠體內的哪種色素吸收光能以進行光合作用？
Which type of endoplasmic reticulum has ribosomes attached to its surface? / 哪種類型的內質網表面附著有核糖體？
options: Rough endoplasmic reticulum / 粗面內質網
Smooth endoplasmic reticulum / 光面內質網

question: Prokaryotic cells have a true nucleus surrounded by a nuclear membrane. / 原核細胞具有由核膜包圍的真細胞核。
Which of the following is an example of a prokaryotic organism? / 下列哪項是原核生物的例子？
options: Onion epidermal cell / 洋蔥表皮細胞

question: If a microscope has a 10× eyepiece and a 40× objective lens, what is the total magnification? / 如果顯微鏡的目鏡為 10×，物鏡為 40×，總放大率是多少？
Compared with a light microscope, a transmission electron microscope produces images with higher magnification and higher resolution. / 與光學顯微鏡相比，透射電子顯微鏡產生的影像具有更高的放大率和更高的解像度。
Which microscope produces 3D images of the external surface of a specimen? / 哪種顯微鏡能產生標本外表面的三維（3D）影像？
options: Scanning electron microscope (SEM) / 掃描電子顯微鏡
Transmission electron microscope (TEM) / 透射電子顯微鏡

question: What is the correct order of levels of organization in a multicellular organism from simplest to most complex? / 多細胞生物由最簡單到最複雜的組織層次正確順序是什麼？
options: Cell → Tissue → Organ → System → Organism / 細胞 → 組織 → 器官 → 系統 → 生物體
Tissue → Cell → Organ → System → Organism / 組織 → 細胞 → 器官 → 系統 → 生物體
Cell → Organ → Tissue → System → Organism / 細胞 → 器官 → 組織 → 系統 → 生物體
Organ → Tissue → Cell → System → Organism / 器官 → 組織 → 細胞 → 系統 → 生物體

question: Which of the following is an example of a plant organ? / 下列哪項是植物器官的例子？
A group of similar cells working together to perform a specific function is called a tissue. / 一群相似的細胞共同合作執行特定功能稱為組織。
Which liquid inside a plant cell's large central vacuole helps keep the cell turgid? / 植物細胞大液泡內的哪種液體有助於保持細胞硬挺？
Why are animal cells usually irregular in shape compared with plant cells? / 與植物細胞相比，為什麼動物細胞通常形狀不規則？
options: They lack chloroplasts / 它們缺乏葉綠體
They lack a cell wall / 它們缺乏細胞壁
They have a large central vacuole / 它們有大液泡
They lack a nucleus / 它們缺乏細胞核

question: New cells are always produced from pre-existing living cells. / 新細胞總是由已存在的活細胞產生的。
